name: Sprague Woodworking Co
old_description: Quality Craftsmanship and Superior Personal Service since 1979
about:
Sprague Woodworking Co. has been based in Harvard, Massachusetts since 1979. The family-owned and operated shop was founded on a commitment to quality craftsmanship and personal service, and it remains a family-run business today.

The company specializes in custom solid wood countertops, including butcher block and plank styles, as well as shelves, desktops, and tabletops. Each piece is handcrafted from an extensive inventory of domestic hardwoods, with the option to source reclaimed or exotic species. Sprague Woodworking also provides professional templating and installation services within a 120-mile radius of its shop, along with a range of finish options to suit any design.

Its work appears in residential projects throughout New England, from Boston brownstones to coastal retreats. The shop serves homeowners, builders, and designers seeking one-of-a-kind wood surfaces for kitchens, bathrooms, and commercial spaces.

The company emphasizes unmatched personal service from initial consultation through installation, a principle that has guided its operation since its founding.
